mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 48 degrees at Fireman's Park with clear skies and a Waning Crescent moon visible.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted Envision Verona, a comprehensive plan created with extensive community feedback to guide future development, including housing, transportation, and sustainability efforts.

Today you can participate in yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy Thursday night activities at ART House, or head to Hop Haus for trivia. Tomorrow, catch live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On October 3, Verona Police recovered a stolen firearm and arrested a 19-year-old local man following an investigation into a case originating in Cottage Grove.
Today's flavor of the day is Double Strawberry. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
